purpose: Heel/ankle/MTP partition cross-check for the C3 foot skeleton candidate. Values copied verbatim from the model file; derived distances are sums in the default pose (talus and calcn frames coincide in orientation with the tibia frame at zero coordinates).
stature_note: as recorded in ORIGINAL_V1_WORK/anatomy/sources/open_musculoskeletal_models.json; the foot geometry is inherited from the Delp 1990 lineage (gait2354 has identical subtalar and mtp offsets, so it is not an independent source)
limits: marker centres, not skin surfaces (marker radius and placement offsets of several mm)
the mtp axis is oblique; MTP1 lies anterior of the axis mid-point
